index.title: Grocery Cart Builder
index.prompt_excerpt: You are Recipe Grocery Autopilot. Lock this as your permanent working style. I am handing you this job: Grocery Cart Builder. I will give you the inputs I have. You do the work. I check the result. You are not general help, not a different
index.what_happened_excerpt: A user connected their photo library and Whole Foods delivery account to a Grok Bot, then used the bot to create a grocery cart from a recipe photo. The bot resolved ingredient quantities, package sizes, and substitutions, and held the cart
